description:
About the Role: We are looking for a highly energetic, smart, and responsible Founder Office Intern who will work directly with the Founder across business operations, strategy, technology, AI, and execution. This is not a regular internship. It is an opportunity to become the Founders right hand, learning how businesses are built, scaled, and managed from the inside. If you are ambitious, business-minded, passionate about technology, and willing to take ownership, this role is for you. Key Responsibilities: Work directly with the Founder on strategic and operational initiatives. Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders. Manage the Founders daily priorities, follow-ups, and task execution. Ensure assigned work is completed on time without constant supervision. Conduct market, business, competitor, and technology research. Prepare presentations, reports, proposals, and business documents. Assist in project planning, execution, and process improvement. Research and implement AI tools to improve business productivity. Attend business meetings and maintain meeting notes and action items. Handle confidential information with professionalism. Support business development and operational activities as required. Take ownership of assigned projects and deliver measurable outcomes. Who Should Apply Has completed Graduation (Any Stream). Has excellent communication skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali. Has a strong interest in business, startups, IT, software, AI, and emerging technologies. Has an entrepreneurial mindset and thinks beyond a typical job. Takes ownership and ensures work gets completed without repeated follow-ups. Is proactive, resourceful, and enjoys solving problems. Can work independently as well as collaborate with teams. Is highly organized, disciplined, and detail-oriented. Is willing to work closely with the Founder in a fast-paced startup environment. Believes in delivering results rather than simply completing tasks. Preferred Skills: Knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Notion AI, or similar platforms. Strong internet research and analytical skills. Good understanding of business operations and project management. Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office. Basic understanding of software development, technology, or digital business is an added advantage. Ability to create presentations, reports, and documentation. Additional Advantages (Preferred, Not Mandatory): Valid Driving License (LMV) with confidence in driving four-wheelers. Valid Passport and willingness to travel for business meetings or official work when required. Previous internship or leadership experience in startups, student organizations, or business projects. Experience using AI productivity tools and automation platforms. What We Expect: Smart and quick to learn. Business-driven and growth-oriented. Responsible and accountable. Action-oriented with a strong execution mindset. Curious about technology and innovation. Honest, trustworthy, and disciplined. Comfortable taking initiative and ownership. Flexible with work priorities and occasional extended working hours when business demands. Committed to continuous learning and personal growth. What Youll Learn: Business Strategy Founder-Level Decision Making Startup Operations AI & Business Automation Product Thinking Business Development Leadership & Communication Project Management Technology & Software Business Cross-functional Team Coordination Career Growth: Founder Office Intern Executive Assistant to Founder Founder Associate Business Operations Manager Leadership Team Outstanding performers will be considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and fast-track leadership opportunities. Why Join Us Work directly with the Founder and leadership team. Gain real-world exposure to business strategy and execution. Learn AI, automation, and modern business systems. Develop leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Be part of a fast-growing organization where your ideas and contributions matter. Build a career based on performance, ownership, and impactnot just years of experience. Selection Process: Application Screening Aptitude & Business Mindset Assessment AI & Research Task Personal Interview with the Founder Final Selection Company: Desun Academy Job Title: Founder Office Intern (Executive Assistant to Founder) Location: Kolkata (Work from Office) Employment Type: Full-Time Internship (PPO Opportunity) Salary: Depends on Interview and Quality Stipend: Based on Skills, Potential & Performance Join Us: If you are passionate about business, technology, and AI, have the courage to take responsibility, and want to build a successful career by working closely with a Founder, wed love to hear from you.

title: Assurance - Financial Services/WAM- Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. EY- Assurance - Senior Manager As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements. The opportunity We re looking for individual who should have Assurance related experience in the Asset Management industry. In addition to supporting the management of service delivery for several key clients, the incumbent should have the potential to coach managers in the Asset Management segment, provide technical support, deliver industry training and assist in growing the Asset Management practice. Your key responsibilitie Manage and develop people Be an effective manager by empowering, monitoring, coaching and motivating the team members. Identify development opportunities and training needs for high performing managers. Identify technical and non-technical training needs with respect to client servicing, decision making, people issues, etc Conduct Assurance team s performance reviews, serve as a positive leader and mentor, and play a significant role in the team s performance Manage business and clients Develop and maintain strong relationship network with key contacts in the Asset Management sector of engagement teams Actively support the Sector agenda both in terms of growth and quality initiatives (e.g. improvement of service delivery, standardization of projects, new solutions, etc.) Enhance connectivity between GDS team and engagement teams and leverage good connections to identify more opportunities for work Actively support the communication agenda for the Asset Management sector Support the Segment Leader in developing annual growth, resource and activity plans Monitor KPIs (growth, quality feedback, utilization, risk management compliance, attrition, etc.) for the teams under supervision and take appropriate action wherever required Manage quality of service delivery Identify sector-specific training needs, review and update current curriculum Assist in organizing and providing technical training (both Sector and Assurance methodology) Assist in addressing service delivery quality issues if and when they occur Support exceptional service delivery action programs Establish a practice of Best Practice sharing within the Asset Management Segment teams Skills and attributes for success Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards Asset Management, assurance experience with specific focus on Hedge Funds and Private Equity Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills Strong project and people management skills with experience in serving global clients Strong verbal and written communication skills in English To qualify for the role, you must have Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / CPA/ACCA) Approximately over 10 years of Assurance relevant experience with well-known CA firms. International experience of over 2 years will be an added advantage Ideally, you ll also have Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office. Interest in business and commerciality. What we look for A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide. Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries What we Offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world 
 
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 
 
 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 
 
 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
